changeSet.sql: BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_CATALOG='D3S' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME ='FK_CompanySetting_CompanySetting') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CompanySetting] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_CompanySetting_CompanySetting]; END END
changeSet.rollback: BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_CATALOG='D3S' AND CONSTRAINT_NAME ='FK_CompanySetting_CompanySetting') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CompanySetting] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_CompanySetting_CompanySetting] FOREIGN KEY([CompanyID], [SettingID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[CompanySetting] ([CompanyID], [SettingID]); ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CompanySetting] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_CompanySetting_CompanySetting]; END EBD
